trials.name: the frame walk is skipped, so the bound is measured only after decompressing
the running total resets per frame, so only the largest frame is judged
a declared content size larger than the bound is allowed through
an uncompressed image is exempted from the bound
an unusable bound is accepted instead of refused
the container's magic is not checked
an unimplemented container version is accepted
a body the container claims but does not carry is accepted

_comment: These guards were reached only through `MemoryFileSystem.fromImage` until `vfs-image-transport.test.ts` existed, and `MemoryFileSystem` is being deleted while this module is not -- `module-base-image.ts` and `images/vfs/lib/kandelo-image-fs.ts` both depend on it. Moving a guard's only test is exactly the moment to prove the move kept it, because a test that no longer kills its mutation has quietly deleted the guard. The first four are the decompression bomb: thirteen bytes can declare two gigabytes, so the frame walk refuses BEFORE a decompressor is asked to produce it, sums concatenated frames rather than judging each alone, and applies to uncompressed bytes too. The last three are the container header's refusals.
